name: Aldrich Resources Berhad
overview: 2026年，公司完成股份合并（每4股合并为1股），并推进多元化与收购计划；最新季度营收同比增长31.1%，净利润同比增长214.0%。公告中未披露各业务板块的具体运营变化。
overview_en: In 2026, the Company completed a share consolidation (4 existing shares into 1 consolidated share) and progressed its diversification and acquisition proposals; latest quarterly revenue grew 31.1% YoY and net profit grew 214.0% YoY. No specific operational changes by business segment were disclosed in the announcements.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 公司完成股份合并，并推进多元化与收购计划。
segments.note_en: The Company completed a share consolidation and progressed its diversification and acquisition proposals.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 股份合并完成，343,931,610股合并股份于2026年1月19日在ACE Market上市交易；同时推进多元化与收购计划。
actions.text_en: Share consolidation completed with 343,931,610 consolidated shares listed on the ACE Market on 19 January 2026; diversification and acquisition proposals are also being progressed.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 每4股现有股份合并为1股合并股份，合并股份于2026年1月19日上市。
actions.text_en: Every 4 existing shares were consolidated into 1 consolidated share, with the consolidated shares listed on 19 January 2026.

actions.title: ALRICH - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 股份合并的除权日为2026年1月15日，最后登记日为2026年1月16日。
actions.text_en: Ex-date for the share consolidation was 15 January 2026, with the last date of lodgment on 16 January 2026.

model_changes.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
model_changes.text: 公司推进多元化与收购计划，涉及进入新业务领域及收购资产。
model_changes.text_en: The Company is progressing diversification and acquisition proposals, involving entry into new business areas and acquisition of assets.
